q: By June 30, 2027, North Korea conducts a flight test of an intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM); ground tests of engines or motors and satellite launches do not count
basis: North Korea has not flight-tested an ICBM since the Hwasong-19 on October 31, 2024. Development has continued, however, with a ground test of a solid-fuel engine in September 2025, the unveiling of the Hwasong-20 at a military parade in October 2025, and a solid-fuel motor test in March 2026. The pauses in ICBM flight testing have coincided with periods of U.S.-North Korean summit diplomacy, in 2018–2019 and again since 2025. The probability rises if a Trump-Kim meeting falls through.
rs: An announcement by South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff or Japan's Ministry of Defense that a launch was ICBM-class, or a Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) announcement of an ICBM test
